description: CsNaC₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Cs is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five C atoms. There are a spread of Cs-C bond distances ranging from 3.41-3.50 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six C atoms. There are a spread of Na-C bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Cs, two equivalent Na, and one C atom. The C-C bond length is 1.27 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Cs, four equivalent Na, and one C atom.
